pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened, low-contrast edge gradients. Patches exhibit a reduction in individual pixel area towards the posterior of the subject.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch network with defined nodes at intersections. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible mid-section with variable pixel-width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, textured linear feature along the dorsal edge exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct interruption in the dark dorsal ridge pixels situated approximately mid-way along the visible back, appearing as a lighter-toned gap.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized region of high-luminance pixels on the mid-dorsal ridge, indicating textural and chromatic disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular patch of light-colored pixels on the mid-dorsal region, representing a substantial disruption of the expected mane and pelage topology.
